_meta.policy: No capability is 99%-ready until every dimension is complete. Partial evidence must remain visible.

dimensions.label: Complete live Azure API surface inventory
dimensions.doneWhen: Provider operations, ARM REST specs, SDK/IaC provider calls, and data-plane APIs are reconciled for the capability.

dimensions.label: Parameter variance captures
dimensions.doneWhen: Live captures cover valid-minimal plus negative variations for required fields, api-version, location, SKU, names, parent references, auth, and service-specific constraints.

dimensions.label: State transition captures
dimensions.doneWhen: Create, update, get, list, delete, post-delete, async provisioning, failed provisioning, and parent readiness are captured and normalized.

dimensions.label: Error-shape fidelity
dimensions.doneWhen: Status, Azure error code, response body shape, headers, request IDs, async-operation headers, and retry headers match captured Azure behavior.

dimensions.label: Identity/RBAC behavior
dimensions.doneWhen: Allowed and denied cases are captured for ARM, local token facade, and service data-plane authorization where applicable.

dimensions.label: Retry/eventual consistency behavior
dimensions.doneWhen: Poll intervals, transitional states, eventual read/list behavior, delete timing, and retryable failures are captured or explicitly out of scope.

dimensions.label: IaC-provider behavior
dimensions.doneWhen: Terraform, OpenTofu, Pulumi, Bicep/ARM, and Ansible provider calls can deploy, refresh, diff, update, import where relevant, and destroy against GlobalStack.

dimensions.label: Data-plane behavior
dimensions.doneWhen: Official emulator or GlobalStack facade behavior is tested against real Azure captures for request success, rejection, auth, side effects, and payload semantics.

dimensions.label: Repeat captures for ambiguous behavior
dimensions.doneWhen: Timing-sensitive or inconsistent captures have repeat evidence before normalization.

dimensions.label: Service-specific local facade/emulator integration
dimensions.doneWhen: The local service path is implemented, fail-closed for unknown surfaces, backed by official emulators where available, and covered by local replay tests.
